This restaurant is great, Camillo. So, no more brakes tonight. What do you like doing in your free time?
I love fishing. In Porto Seguro, I go on a boat every Sunday.
Fishing! Nice. Do you like cooking the fish?
No, I don't like cooking. But I love a barbecue with my family. And you? Do you have a hobby?
I love cycling, and I go to the gym after work. But I hate cooking too!
I like watching Formula 1. My dream is to see a race in Germany. I want to visit Munich next year.
Great idea! I want to show you the city. And I want to see your beach in Porto Seguro.
Perfect. You can come fishing with me!
I love fishing, and I like watching Formula 1.
I don't like cooking.
My dream is to see a race in Germany.
I want to visit Munich next year.

Welcome to Porto Seguro Fishing Tours! Do you love fishing? Do you want to relax on the sea? Our boat leaves every Saturday at six in the morning. You don't need your own equipment. Do you hate waking up early? No problem: we also have a tour at two in the afternoon. After the tour, we cook your fish on the beach. Call us today!

Hi Camillo, it's Klaus from Munich. Thanks for your message. You asked about my free time. Well, I love cycling, and I like cooking for my family on Sundays. I hate running, it's boring! And my dream? I want to see a Formula 1 race in Brazil, at Interlagos. Do you want to come with me? Call me back!

Camillo and Laura are having dinner after the auto parts fair in Sao Paulo. Laura asks: What do you like doing in your free time? Camillo says: I love fishing, and I like watching Formula 1. Laura says: I love cycling, but I hate cooking. Camillo says: I want to visit Germany next year. Laura says: Great! I want to show you Munich.
